summary: Fixed in 60633eff3 (#710), which is in HEAD and in the Hub's vendored 7bc39eec3. GitVcsDriver.listWorkspaceFiles now runs `ls-files --cached`, `ls-files --cached --ignored --exclude-standard` and `ls-files --others --exclude-standard` concurrently and subtracts the tracked-but-ignored set. WorkspaceEntries no longer calls filterIgnoredPaths/check-ignore anywhere, and the K-chunk retry is gone. The old readdir-walk fallback inside a work tree, which also ran check-ignore (old line 479), was removed too. A failed full listing now falls back to one cheap tracked-only listing. listWorkspaceFiles has a single production caller (WorkspaceEntries), and git is the only registered VcsDriver, so no other path still pays for check-ignore. I ran a read-only equivalence check on this repo: old pipeline (ls-files -co then check-ignore) and new pipeline (-c minus -ci, plus -o) both gave 7678 paths, as identical sets.

evidence.note: listWorkspaceFiles: three concurrent ls-files runs (Effect.all, concurrency unbounded, fail-fast). Tracked paths in the --cached --ignored set are dropped and adjacent unmerged-stage duplicates are deduped. trackedOnly skips the untracked walk.
listVcsIndex passes driver.listWorkspaceFiles output straight to indexListedFiles. No check-ignore step.
buildWorkspaceIndex: if the full listing fails, it retries once with the tracked-only listing (2 cheap ls-files runs), replacing the old filterVcsIgnoredPaths K-chunk retry (old 359-362).

Two-phase build exists, but only as a deadline fallback. Readers wait up to WORKSPACE_INDEX_COLD_BUILD_DEADLINE_MS = 4000 for the full build, and only then is a tracked-only stand-in listed and published. It is not the proposal's 'answer first from ls-files -c (~30 ms), then merge -o'.
WORKSPACE_FILES_MAX_OUTPUT_BYTES is 32 MiB per ls-files run (raised from 16 MiB in the same commit), not 16 MiB as the auditor said.
filterIgnoredPaths and chunkPathsForGitCheckIgnore remain as dead API. Their only callers are tests and VcsDriverContractHarness.ts:141,158.
Real-git test: a tracked file under a newly ignored dir (generated/stale.json) is excluded in both full and trackedOnly modes.

This contract test uses `.convex/`, which IGNORED_DIRECTORY_NAMES (WorkspaceEntries.ts:84-94) already strips by first segment. It would pass even without the -ci subtraction, so only the driver-level test exercises git-ignore subtraction.
Covers the deadline stand-in, its replacement once the full build lands, and the tracked fallback when the full listing fails.

fixDefects:
No functional defects found. Minor notes, none blocking:
(1) The auditor's 'matches the optional proposal part' overstates it. The tracked-only stand-in only starts after the 4 s cold-build deadline (WorkspaceEntries.ts:64,889-903), so the report's 'first results in about 30 ms' is not realized for normal repos. The first cold '@' still waits for the untracked walk (~45-50 ms here, ~165-210 ms at 60k files). It is still well below the old check-ignore cost, and the proposal marked this part optional.
(2) Past the deadline, startDegradedBuild re-spawns `ls-files --cached` and `--cached --ignored` (WorkspaceEntries.ts:878 -> GitVcsDriver.ts:562-563), although the still-running full build has usually already finished those two runs. That is two redundant processes, only on >4 s cold builds.
(3) The output cap is 32 MiB, not 16 MiB. A truncated `--cached --ignored` run could leak a few ignored tracked paths, which is negligible.
(4) The WorkspaceEntries-level test 'excludes tracked paths that match ignore rules' is weak: `.convex` is already in IGNORED_DIRECTORY_NAMES.
(5) filterIgnoredPaths and chunkPathsForGitCheckIgnore are dead outside tests.
implementationSketch:
Nothing required for this finding. Optional cleanups:
(a) Remove filterIgnoredPaths from VcsDriverShape (VcsDriver.ts:34), GitVcsDriver.ts (filterIgnoredPaths, chunkPathsForGitCheckIgnore, GIT_CHECK_IGNORE_MAX_STDIN_BYTES) and the test stubs (server.test.ts:632,3814; VcsProvisioningService.test.ts:50; WorkspaceEntries.index.test.ts:58). Replace the contract harness 'ignored path filtering' block with a listWorkspaceFiles case for tracked-but-ignored files.
(b) Change WorkspaceEntries.test.ts:220-237 to use a directory name not in IGNORED_DIRECTORY_NAMES (e.g. `generated/`), so the layer test actually exercises the -ci subtraction.
(c) If a faster first cold answer is wanted, build `--cached` and `--cached --ignored` once inside listWorkspaceFiles and expose them through an optional `onTracked` callback, or a two-stage result. buildWorkspaceIndex would publish a tracked stand-in immediately, or at a short deadline such as 250 ms, instead of re-spawning at 4 s. Test with WorkspaceEntries.index.test.ts TestClock cases. This trades a flicker of partial results for latency, which is a UX choice.
decisionReason: The core fix is a pure process-spawn optimization with an equivalent result set. Only optional item (c), serving tracked-only results immediately and then swapping in the full set, would be a product UX trade-off. It is not needed to close this finding.
correction: Status and core conclusion are right. Two details are off. (1) The output cap is 32 MiB, not 16 MiB. (2) The two-phase build does not match the optional proposal: it is a 4 s deadline fallback, not an immediate ~30 ms tracked-first answer, and the fallback re-spawns two ls-files runs the full build has already done. Also, the cited WorkspaceEntries contract test (`.convex/`) passes from IGNORED_DIRECTORY_NAMES alone. Only GitVcsDriver.listWorkspaceFiles.test.ts truly covers the tracked-but-ignored subtraction.
